content: ⌊ DRAFT g If Nm_PncBitVectorRxIndication is called, NmP- nEiraCalcEnabled or NmPnEraCalcEnabled is set to TRUE and at least one PNC bit is detected as relevant PNC request according to [SWS_Nm_00311] in the given PNC bit vector, the OUT parameter RelevantPncRequestDetectedPtr shall be set to TRUE. Otherwise the value of RelevantPncRequestDetectedPtr shall be set to FALSE.

If Nm_PncBitVectorRxIndication is called, NmPnEiraCal- cEnabled or NmPnEraCalcEnabled is set to TRUE and at least one PNC bit is de- tected as relevant PNC request according to [SWS_Nm_00311] in the given PNC bit vector , the OUT parameter RelevantPncRequestDetectedPtr shall be set to TRUE. Otherwise the value of RelevantPncRequestDetectedPtr shall be set to FALSE.
